formalRulesComparator.tokenMechanism: One or more Jackpot Activation tokens on a reel increase that reel's associated jackpot and can award it.
formalRulesComparator.awardAtMaximum: The jackpot is awarded automatically when the maximum is reached through the jackpot event progression.

providerPatent.title: Method and system for configuring a computing system with multiple jackpot state computer-implemented game
providerPatent.constantRtpConstruction: If jackpot value grows by factor x, trigger probability can be divided by x so the jackpot RTP remains unchanged.
providerPatent.finalStateRule: The capped value cannot be reached without the jackpot being awarded; at the penultimate state increment-only probability is zero.

workedExample.mismatchReason: Minotaur's purple tier uses the same 5x-to-15x range but formal rules specify 0.4x increments, while the patent worked example uses 0.5x. The table is therefore a mathematical family example, not evidence of Minotaur's exact control table.

conditionalTheorem.statement: If the deployed Minotaur Rising Rewards implementation uses the patent's constant-jackpot-RTP construction, jackpot meter height alone cannot increase expected return: p(v)*v is constant by design.
conditionalTheorem.proof: For jackpot component RTP q and current value v, p(v)=q/v. Therefore EV_jackpot(v)=p(v)*v=q for every state. Increasing v lowers p in exact inverse proportion and does not change the jackpot component's RTP.
conditionalTheorem.consequence: A strategy that plays solely because a meter is near Must Hit By is not scientifically justified unless the deployed hazard function is shown to deviate from the constant-RTP construction or another state-dependent component creates positive EV.
